basic_profile.bio: Avid Pokémon Go player and gardening enthusiast living in Round Rock, Texas. I spend my mornings tending to my allotment, where I grow everything from heirloom tomatoes to exotic herbs. Afternoons are often reserved for Pokémon Go raids and community days. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows for a flexible schedule. Married with two kids who often join me on Pokémon hunts. Typically online in the early mornings and late evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise spans graphic design and community gardening. I hold a degree in Fine Arts and have been self-teaching app development in my spare time. I've also been an active participant in Pokémon Go communities for several years, contributing to strategy discussions and raid coordination.
